questions.question: How do partials and layouts work in Rails views?
questions.title: Partials and Layouts
questions.direct_answer: Partials are reusable view snippets: a file named with a leading underscore (_form.html.erb) rendered with render 'form' (Rails drops the underscore and extension). They DRY up repeated view code — the same form for new and edit. Layouts are the page shell that wraps an action's view: app/views/layouts/application.html.erb has the <head>, nav, and <%= yield %> where the action's content goes. Every action renders inside the layout by default. You can pick a layout (layout 'admin') or render a partial from anywhere (render 'shared/nav'). Partials + layouts let you compose pages from shared pieces without repeating HTML.

interviewer_intent.testing: Whether you know partials are _name files rendered with render 'name' (DRY repeated views) and layouts wrap the action with yield.
interviewer_intent.common_mistake: Naming a partial without the leading underscore (render looks for _form.html.erb), or forgetting yield in the layout (no action content shows).

sections.title: Partials + Layout
sections.content:
Partials (_name) DRY repeated views; layouts wrap the action with <%= yield %>.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  L[layout: application.html.erb] --> Y[yield -> action view]
  V[view] --> P[render 'form' -> _form.html.erb]
  P --> S[shared partials: 'shared/nav']
```

class AdminController < ApplicationController layout 'admin' end ```

sections.title: Common Mistakes
items: Naming a partial without the leading underscore (render looks for _form.html.erb).
Forgetting <%= yield %> in the layout — no action content shows.
Duplicating HTML that a partial or layout could share.

sections.title: Key Takeaways
items: Partials are _name.html.erb files, rendered with render 'name' (Rails drops _ and .erb).
Partials DRY up repeated view code — the same _form for new and edit.
Layouts (application.html.erb) wrap every action; <%= yield %> is where the action renders.
You can pick a layout (layout 'admin') and pass locals to partials (render 'x', user:).
Partials + layouts compose pages from shared pieces without repeating HTML.

Layouts are the page shell that wraps an action's view: app slash views slash layouts slash application dot html dot erb has the head, nav, and yield where the action's content goes. Every action renders inside the layout by default. You can pick a layout (layout admin) or render a partial from anywhere (render shared slash nav). Partials plus layouts let you compose pages from shared pieces without repeating HTML.
